frame.world_definition: Identity-aligned with the MuJoCo world and raicom_room_frame in scene_workspace.xml.

scene_world_from_odom.meaning: Pose of the odom floor origin and axes expressed in raicom_scene_world.

odom_from_scene_world.meaning: Inverse transform used to convert scene-world navigation goals into odom coordinates.

odom_reset_anchor.event: MuJoCo Reset to the configured START root pose
odom_reset_anchor.odom_origin_definition: Floor projection of the pelvis/root at START; odom +X is aligned with the START heading.

verification.method: Pure SE(2) transform/inverse and scene XML root-frame composition checks in tests/test_scene_world_poses.py.
verification.live_reset_or_ros_odom_sample: NOT_RUN; no physics or navigation runtime was started in this task.
verification.enablement_gate: A live Reset must publish the expected odom pose before a navigation goal publisher consumes this transform.

START.source: RAICOM room START marker and scene_workspace x2_start_frame composed with the unchanged MC/runtime X2 local home pose.

START_ALIGN.source: Static in-place alignment pose from the previously validated scene-world route.

WAYPOINT.source: Previously validated straight south-corridor intermediate pose.

TABLE_DOCKING.source: Center of the RAICOM WORK marker; X2 faces +X toward the table west side. Static clearance pass only; not dynamic navigation evidence.

MUG_SOURCE.static_support: NO_CONTACT; source pose leaves a 0.00276906 m collision gap above the table.

LOCAL04_MUG_TABLE_TANGENCY.note: Derived source-table tangency placement for the Local04 static grasp fixture; the existing audit observed no active MuJoCo table contact at exact tangency. Not the source scene mug pose.
